title: Fluent Named to Crain’s New York Business 2026 Best Places to Work
summary: Fluent, Inc. (NASDAQ: FLNT) named to Crain's New York 2026 Best Places to Work list, reflecting its people-first culture amid strong growth.
body_markdown:
**NEW YORK — September 24, 2026 —** Fluent, Inc. (NASDAQ: FLNT), a leading provider of commerce media solutions, has been named to Crain’s New York Business 2026 Best Places to Work list. The recognition reflects the strength of Fluent’s team and the culture built across the organization. Fluent has regularly earned a place on the list, and as the Company continues to grow, its people remain the foundation everything else is built on.


The recognition comes as Fluent enters a new phase of growth, with its Commerce Media Solutions business playing an increasingly significant role in the Company’s overall strategy. Commerce Media Solutions revenue grew 90% year-over-year in the second quarter, as Fluent expands its capabilities across digital and physical commerce, grows its network of media partners, and moves into new categories including travel, lifestyle, and home services. The recent launch of Fluent In-Store marks another step in that expansion, bringing the Company’s commerce media capabilities to the physical point of sale, where ~80% of purchases happen today.


That growth is also shaping the employee experience at Fluent. As Fluent continues to evolve its business and build a more connected commerce media offering, employees across all functions have opportunities to contribute to new initiatives, collaborate across teams, and grow alongside the Company.


“At Fluent, our success starts and ends with our people,” said Don Patrick, CEO of Fluent. “This recognition from Crain’s New York Business – which has recognized Fluent for multiple years – is a direct reflection of the team we’ve built and the culture they’ve created.”


Fluent invests in an employee experience built around flexibility, development, and connection, offering hybrid work options, mentorship opportunities, mental health resources, and flexible schedules designed to support employees grow professionally and live well outside of the office.


“Joining Fluent as CMO at this point in the Company’s growth has given me a firsthand look at the talent and collaboration behind the business,” said Jeanniey Walden, Chief Marketing Officer at Fluent. “There is a real sense of momentum across the organization, and that comes from people who are invested in what they are building together. I’m excited to be part of this team and to help support Fluent as it continues to grow.”


The Crain’s New York Business Best Places to Work program is conducted in partnership with Best Companies Group, an independent research firm. This year’s winners represent organizations across New York that set the standard for workplace excellence, recognizing companies that prioritize their people and workplace culture.

Leveraging exclusive ad inventory, robust first-party data, privacy-first infrastructure, and proprietary machine learning, Fluent unlocks additional revenue streams for partners and empowers advertisers to acquire their most valuable customers at scale.
